description: How far one owner may reach, authored by the installation beside the company's registration. The zero ceiling (an empty document) allows nothing, so a missing ceiling never reads as no limit.

aws_accounts.description: The AWS accounts a workload of the owner may run in.

clusters.description: The clusters a workload of the owner may run in.

directories.description: The email domains every address and directory group of the owner must belong to: `acme.example`.

github_orgs.description: The GitHub organisation logins the owner holds.

groups.description: Patterns of the internal groups the owner may mint or be granted: `scope:thing:role`, where `*` stands for one whole segment and never for the installation-wide scope `all`.

rungs.description: The rungs the owner may add people to.

slack_workspaces.description: The Slack workspace keys the owner holds.

title: The ceiling of a company's access fragment
